faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Investigating Jay Hickey's disappearance reveals the deep influence of his astrologer…
kurzfassung: As the search for missing resident Jay Hickey continues, investigators uncover how deeply his life was shaped by his famous astrologer grandmother, Isabelle Hickey. A retired police officer takes it upon himself to investigate the case, convinced that a suspicious property sale holds dark secrets. Meanwhile, old book royalties and strange text messages from Jay's phone add further confusion to the police inquiry.
stichpunkte: Retired police officer Joe Murphy investigates Jay Hickey's disappearance out of loyalty to Jay's grandmother.
Isabelle Hickey was a prominent New Age figure and astrologer known as Boston's spiritual spark plug.
Jay grew up closely with his grandmother at her spiritual retreat in Nottingham, New Hampshire.
As a young man, Jay successfully applied for conscientious objector status during the Vietnam War with help from his grandmother's connections.
Guided by what he called his higher self, Jay eventually purchased a Christmas tree farm in Epsom.
Collaborator Amy Shapiro discovers unsigned royalty checks and receives erratic text messages sent from Jay's phone.
Joe Murphy develops a bold conspiracy theory involving the sale of the Christmas tree farm and foul play.
Police find no concrete evidence linking the property buyers to any crime, leaving the mystery unsolved.

clips.text: Childhood memories reveal how deeply the grandmother's spiritual instruction impacted the subject throughout his entire life.
An associate discovers that a recent financial payout meant for the missing man was deposited without a proper signature.
Public records show that a large acreage and home were sold to neighbors for a fraction of expected market value.
The investigator explains his extreme gut feeling regarding how the missing man may have met a violent end.

beschreibung:
A volunteer sleuth digs into Jay's case and reveals a surprising connection to a major figure in the world of astrology, a "Spiritual Sparkplug" named Isabel Hickey.
